test.name: /research slash command triggers the orchestrator
test.description: The /research [question] form is an explicit trigger listed in the skill description. The user is handing off a specific research question to be driven through the full GPS workflow.
test.xfail_reason: Slash-command entry records no Skill call, so skills_invoked never holds `research` and the positive-test activation check fails it. The marker only binds when the run reaches that check — an aborted run is not remapped. Remove this marker when the harness records slash entry.

input.user_message: /research When and where did Patrick Flynn die?

judge_context: The /research prefix is an explicit skill trigger
Should drive the question through the GPS workflow, not just answer it conversationally
